title: Adaptor Pattern
overview: Convert the interface of a class into another interface clients expect, letting incompatible classes work together.
useCases: You have a class that wants to use another class but its interface is incompatible with what you expect
The class with the incompatible interface cannot or should not be changed
Integrating a third-party library or legacy code into a system that expects a different interface
exampleUses: Wrapping an old XML-based reporting library behind a JSON interface that the rest of the application uses
Bridging a payment provider's SDK to a common PaymentGateway interface shared across multiple providers
Adapting a legacy authentication service to implement a modern OAuth-style interface without rewriting it
